text.개발·테스트용: 모델을 부르지 않고 설정한 규칙대로 에이전트 실행(응답·: For development and testing: simulates an agent run (replies, tools, delegation, questions, hooks, failures and delays) by the rules you set, without calling a model.
text.응답 전에 사용자에게 묻거나 승인을 받는 흉내 하나입니다. 되묻기 흐름을: One simulated question or approval request to the user before the reply. Use it to test the question flow.
Kind of request to open (e.g. question).
Change this to check other request cards, such as approval.
Change this to check how the request card title looks.
Guidance text of the request card.
Change this to check how the request card guidance looks.
Extra content the request kind accepts.
Format of the expected response. Leave empty to use the kind default.
How long to wait for an answer. Leave empty to use the setting.
Location in the response of the value to put in $answer_N (e.g. /text).
text.다른 에이전트에게 일을 맡긴 것처럼 흉내 낼 위임 하나입니다. 위임 흐름: One simulated delegation, as if work were handed to another agent. Use it to test the delegation flow.
Name of the subagent to hand work to (target node id).
Change this to check handing work to a different agent.
Template of the work to pass to the target. $prompt is the received prompt.
Change this to change the work being handed off.
Short description attached to the delegation call. Leave empty to use the target description.
text.대상이 돌려줄 답의 틀입니다. $prompt·$agent_name 등을: Template of the answer the target returns. You can use $prompt, $agent_name and so on.
Change this to change the delegate's answer.
Tool calls to record as made by the target.
text.대상이 끝난 상태입니다(completed, failed, stopped): Status the target ends with (completed, failed, stopped).
How long to wait before finishing.
Usage of the target. Leave empty to count it from characters and calls.
text.정한 만큼 답을 낸 뒤 실행을 실패시킵니다. 실패 처리·재시도를 시험할: Fails the run after producing the set amount of answer. Use it to test failure handling and retries.
Error code to use when ending with a failure.
Change this to check a different error.
text.실패로 끝낼 때 보일 문구입니다. 비우면 기본 문구(fake 백엔드가 설: Text to show when ending with a failure. Leave empty to use the default text (The fake backend failed as configured).
Change this to check how the error text looks on screen.
Fails after producing this many text chunks.
Simulates one record line of a hook (a command that runs before or after a tool). The command is not run.
text.기록할 hook(도구 실행 전후에 도는 명령) 이벤트 이름입니다(예: P: Name of the hook (a command that runs before or after a tool) event to record (e.g. PreToolUse).
Change this to check the record of a different hook event.
Target filter of the hook (a command that runs before or after a tool) to record.
Template of the tool call id to record.
Template of the hook (a command that runs before or after a tool) input to record.
Command exit code to record. Leave empty to record a failure to run.
text.기록할 hook(도구 실행 전후에 도는 명령) 결정입니다(예: allow: hook (a command that runs before or after a tool) decision to record (e.g. allow, deny).
text.시작 직후(start), 도구 호출 뒤(tool), 끝(end) 중 언제: When to write it: right after the start (start), after tool calls (tool) or at the end (end).
Name of the record format. You usually don't change this.
Keys to add to or overwrite in the record.
text.응답 전에 부를 플랫폼 도구 호출 하나입니다. 결과를 응답에 넣을 수 있: One platform tool call to make before the reply. The result can go into the reply.
Name of the platform tool to call (e.g. the delegation tool).
Change this to check a different platform tool call.
Template of the input to pass to the tool. You can use $prompt and so on.
Change this to change the values passed to the tool.
Decides whether to call based on earlier results. Leave empty to always call.
Appends the tool result to the end of the answer.
Condition that looks at an earlier platform tool result to decide whether to make this call.
Number of the earlier call whose result to check (from 1). Leave empty for the call right before.
Calls only if the earlier result contains this text.
Fill this in to check skipping a call based on the earlier result.
Calls only if the earlier result doesn't contain this text.
Checks whether the earlier result is an error (on) or not (off).
text.hook(도구 실행 전후에 도는 명령)·MCP(외부 도구 서버) 관측 이: Simulated observation event of a hook (a command that runs before or after a tool) or MCP (external tool server).
text.흉내 낼 관측 이벤트 이름입니다(예: hook.invoked = hook: Name of the observation event to simulate (e.g. hook.invoked = a hook (a command before or after a tool) ran).
Change this to simulate a different observation event.
Template of the content the event carries.
text.시작 직후(start), 도구 호출 뒤(tool), 끝(end) 중 언제: When to emit it: right after the start (start), after tool calls (tool) or at the end (end).
Name of the observation setting that must be on. Leave empty to decide from the event type.
text.프롬프트가 조건에 맞으면 정해 둔 응답을 냅니다. 조건은 모두 맞아야 합: Produces the set reply when the prompt matches the conditions. All conditions must match.
Uses this rule if the prompt contains this text.
Fill this in to use this answer only for messages that contain certain words.
Uses this rule if the prompt starts with this text.
Uses this rule if the prompt equals this text.
Template of the answer to return. You can use $prompt, $agent_name and so on.
Change this to change the content of the sample answer.
Structured result to return along with it (passed as is).
Tool calls to record as made before the answer.
Subagent delegations to simulate in order.
Question and approval requests to open in order before the answer.
Platform tools to call in order after delegation.
text.관측을 켰을 때 낼 hook(도구 실행 전후에 도는 명령)·MCP(외부: hook (a command that runs before or after a tool) and MCP (external tool server) events to emit when observation is on.
text.hook(도구 실행 전후에 도는 명령) 전체 기록이 켜졌을 때 남길 기록: Records to leave when full hook (a command that runs before or after a tool) recording is on.
If set, fails with this content instead of answering.
How long to wait between text chunks. Leave empty to use the overall setting.
Number of characters in one text chunk. Leave empty to use the overall setting.
Usage to report. Leave empty to count it from words.
text.마지막 사용량 기록에 실을 모델 호출 소요 시간입니다. 비우면 싣지 않습: Model call duration to include in the last usage record. Leave empty to leave it out (unknown).
Fill this in to check how the model call duration shows on the observation screens.
text.서브에이전트가 쓴 것처럼 보고할 사용량(토큰·도구 사용 수·소요 시간)입: Usage (tokens, tool uses and duration) to report as if the subagent used it.
Number of tool uses to report.
text.응답 중에 도구를 쓴 것처럼 보여 줄 호출 하나입니다. 도구 기록 화면을: One call to show as if a tool were used during the reply. Use it to check the tool record screens.
Tool name of the tool call to simulate.
Change this to simulate a different tool call.
Tool input to include in the record.
Tool result to include in the record.
When on, records this tool call as failed.
text.모델 없이 정해 둔 응답을 내는 시험용 실행 설정입니다. 위 규칙부터 처: Test run settings that produce set replies without a model. The first matching rule from the top is used.
text.프롬프트에 따라 답을 고르는 규칙입니다. 위에서부터 처음 맞는 것을 씁니: Rules that pick the answer by prompt. The first match from the top is used.
Add rules to check different answers for different messages.
Default number of characters in one text chunk.
Appends a summary of the received resource bundle to the end of the answer (for checking the screen).
No model is called, so there's no usage.
No model is called, so there's no cost.
A scripted demo sign-in (no real account or files are used).
Demo: this isn't a real sign-in. Enter ok as the code to succeed.
Sign in in the browser (demo address).
Paste the code shown in the browser (demo: ok).
Couldn't confirm the sign-in. Try again.
The rule used when no rule matches.
Change this to change the reply when no rule matches.
